text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Scarlet. I'm preparing a present
for your
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You frequently like to use aroma oils,
yes? As
such, I'm concocting a blend
using a new, secret
formula.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Worry not, it won't be harmful to
breathe in. At
worst, some particulate
matter might adhere to
you and emit a
sparkling—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, but the light is probably not
what
you're imagining. You see, the
seven colors—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's rainbow colored?! Wow! And you
made it for
me—I'm so happy! I'll really
cherish it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Heehee, I can't wait to show it off. ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Is that right? Well, then I hope you'll
look
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Hmm... It shouldn't cause any problems, but I'm a little uneasy.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(...Perhaps I'll make a few more
adjustments
before giving it to her.)
